scope: Owner-env public-key normalization and explicit format diagnostics only

tests.expect: A valid 64-hex Ed25519 public key is accepted after surrounding whitespace is stripped and ASCII hex is lower-cased
A present but malformed owner-env key yields DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY with reason KEY_FORMAT:<variable>
Missing one or both keys remains INDEPENDENT_EFFECT_DOMAINS_MISSING and never becomes READY
Two normalized keys must remain distinct; duplicate key material remains INDEPENDENT_EFFECT_DOMAINS_MISSING
The full frozen R4 suite and mutants remain green; PREPARE_ONLY and STOP behavior are unchanged
